K_S1C1.title: First Steps
K_S1C1.goal: Move the turtle forward to the target.
K_S1C1.learningObjective: Learn the 'forward(n)' command and understand that computers follow instructions in sequence.

K_S1C2.title: A Simple Turn
K_S1C2.goal: Turn the turtle to face the target, then move forward.
K_S1C2.learningObjective: Learn the 'turn(d)' command for changing direction.

K_S1C3.title: Box Step 1: Forward and Turn
K_S1C3.goal: Move forward 100, then turn right (90 degrees).

K_S1C4.title: Box Step 2: Two Sides
K_S1C4.goal: Draw two sides of a square (Forward 100, Turn 90, Forward 100).

K_S1C5.title: Box Step 3: Three Sides
K_S1C5.goal: Draw three sides of a square (F 100, T 90, F 100, T 90, F 100).

K_S1C6.title: Complete the Square
K_S1C6.goal: Draw a full square (side length 100) to return to the start.
K_S1C6.learningObjective: Complete a closed shape using a sequence of repeated commands.

K_S1C7.title: Staircase
K_S1C7.goal: Move in a staircase pattern to reach the top right.

G1_S1C1.title: Pen Colors
G1_S1C1.goal: Draw a red line, then a blue line.
G1_S1C1.learningObjective: Learn the 'penColor(c)' command to change the turtle's trail color.

G1_S1C2.title: Lift the Pen
G1_S1C2.goal: Move to a new spot without drawing a line.
G1_S1C2.learningObjective: Learn 'penUp()' and 'penDown()' to control when the turtle draws.

G1_S1C3.title: Dashed Line
G1_S1C3.goal: Draw a dashed line (draw, lift, move, lower, draw).

G1_S1C4.title: Introduction to Loops
G1_S1C4.goal: Use 'repeat 4 { forward(50) }' to draw a line 4 times (for now, just draw a long line).
G1_S1C4.learningObjective: Learn the 'repeat N { ... }' command to repeat actions.

G1_S1C5.title: Draw a Square with a Loop
G1_S1C5.goal: Use 'repeat 4 { forward(100) turn(90) }' to draw a square.
G1_S1C5.learningObjective: Use a loop to draw a regular shape efficiently.

G1_S1C6.title: Looping Colors
G1_S1C6.goal: Use a loop to draw 4 lines of different colors (change color inside the loop).
G1_S1C6.learningObjective: Experiment with changing state inside a loop.

G1_S1C7.title: Nested Loops
G1_S1C7.goal: Try using a loop inside another loop! (e.g. repeat 4 { repeat 3 { ... } }).

G2_S1C1.title: My First Function
G2_S1C1.goal: Define a sequence of commands to draw a shape, then call it.
G2_S1C1.learningObjective: Understand the concept of abstraction by defining and calling a simple function.

G2_S1C2.title: Function with Parameters
G2_S1C2.goal: Create a function that takes a 'size' parameter to draw shapes of different sizes.
G2_S1C2.learningObjective: Learn how to make functions more flexible with parameters.
